catalog.name: Aluminum 6061-T6
catalog.summary: General-purpose aluminum alloy. High strength-to-weight ratio, good corrosion resistance. Common in aerospace and structural applications.

catalog.name: Stainless Steel 304
catalog.summary: Austenitic stainless steel. Excellent corrosion resistance, high strength, widely used in food processing, chemical, and architectural applications.

catalog.name: Titanium Ti-6Al-4V
catalog.summary: Most common titanium alloy. Exceptional strength-to-weight ratio and corrosion resistance. Used in aerospace, medical implants, and marine applications.

catalog.name: Copper C110 (ETP)
catalog.summary: Electrolytic tough pitch copper. Highest thermal and electrical conductivity among common engineering metals. Used in heat exchangers, bus bars, and electrical components.
